_comments: DAILY CONTRACT ORDER RELINK (contracts#77). Its own file for the same coordination reason as
`.sales-forecast-actions.json`: MetadataSync reads every dot-json here, so separate files do not
Links each won deal's order to its contract where the link is missing: deals closed while the
installed contracts had no order links, and links refused at close time. Skips, successfully,
while contracts has no Contract Orders entity, which is what makes it safe to ship Active.

fields.Name: Relink Won Deal Orders To Contracts
fields.Description: Link every won deal's order to its contract where the deal has both and no link exists, so contracts can copy the contract's renewal terms to the order's subscriptions. Idempotent: an existing link is left alone. Skips while the installed bizapps-contracts has no order links.
fields.UserPrompt: Link won deals' orders to their contracts where the link is missing.
